children.name: Pecaroecus javalii
children.description: Pecaroecus javalii, the giant sucking louse or peccary louse, is a species of sucking louse. It is the only species in the genus Pecaroecus and family Pecaroecidae. This species was first discovered in 1932 by Babcock and Ewing on a one-month-old javelina in west Texas.
